bmi-calculator: Check an adult BMI screening value before discussing weight and height with a healthcare professional.
calorie-calculator: Compare an estimated maintenance intake with a self-chosen daily planning adjustment.
body-fat-calculator: Use a rough adult body-fat estimate when a direct body-composition measurement is unavailable, keeping its error in mind.
bmr-calculator: Separate estimated resting energy from movement when reviewing a daily calorie plan.
macro-calculator: Convert a chosen calorie split into approximate grams of protein, carbohydrates, and fat for meal planning.
ideal-weight-calculator: Compare the spread of four legacy height-based equations rather than treating one as a personal target.
pregnancy-calculator: Get an approximate pregnancy due date from the last menstrual period for an initial calendar reference.
pregnancy-weight-gain-calculator: Compare pregnancy gain with a published singleton or twin reference range before discussing an individual target with prenatal care.
pregnancy-conception-calculator: Estimate a possible conception date from pregnancy dating for general calendar orientation only.
due-date-calculator: Compare conventional due-date estimates using the dating information available from a cycle or IVF transfer.
pace-calculator: Convert a training time and distance into pace per kilometre or mile before comparing workouts.
army-body-fat-calculator: Calculate waist-to-height ratio as an informal comparison with the current Army screening threshold.
carbohydrate-calculator: Translate a selected share of daily calories into carbohydrate grams for nutrition planning.
lean-body-mass-calculator: Separate estimated fat mass and lean mass when a body-fat estimate is already available.
healthy-weight-calculator: See the adult BMI reference weight interval that corresponds to a given height.
calories-burned-calculator: Compare approximate energy use across activities using duration, body weight, and an average MET value.
one-rep-max-calculator: Estimate a training load from a submaximal set without treating the result as a tested maximum.
target-heart-rate-calculator: Use age-predicted heart-rate zones as a broad exercise reference, subject to individual medical guidance.
protein-calculator: Translate a chosen grams-per-kilogram protein target into a daily amount for meal planning.
fat-intake-calculator: Convert a chosen calorie percentage from fat into approximate grams and calories.
tdee-calculator: Estimate total daily energy from resting expenditure and a selected activity factor.
ovulation-calculator: View a calendar-based ovulation estimate and fertile window while accounting for cycle uncertainty.
conception-calculator: Use cycle dates to estimate likely ovulation timing, not an exact fertilization date.
period-calculator: Project the next expected period from an average cycle length for calendar tracking.
gfr-calculator: Review an equation-based eGFR estimate alongside clinical testing and medical interpretation.
body-type-calculator: Compare bust, waist, and hip measurements to explore a simple clothing-fit silhouette description.
body-surface-area-calculator: Calculate Mosteller body surface area when a clinical reference explicitly asks for it.
bac-calculator: See an uncertain educational alcohol model only; it cannot determine whether driving is safe.
anorexic-bmi-calculator: Review a very low adult BMI screening value without using BMI to diagnose an eating disorder.
weight-watchers-points-calculator: Compare an older recipe with a documented historical calories-fat-fiber score or track a budget you entered yourself.
overweight-calculator: Compare adult BMI with the screening threshold of 25 without treating the result as a diagnosis.
